p4_b0.ocr: In evaluating the exploration drilling results for Vale SA in North America, the data presented in the following table highlights significant developments in mineral resource assessments over the past few years. The results from 2020 demonstrated a promising increase in activity, with a total of 20 drill holes completed, averaging 5.2 grams per tonne (g/t) of gold, indicating robust mineralization in targeted zones. As we moved into 2021, further exploration efforts continued to yield encouraging results, leading to the completion of 35 drill holes, which confirmed the presence of high-grade mineral deposits. Notably, the average gold grade achieved during this period was 6.0 g/t, an improvement that underscores the effectiveness of our exploration strategy.

p4_b1.ocr: In 2021, the ongoing exploration initiatives were bolstered by the successful identification of new targets, which were subsequently drilled in 2022. This proactive approach allowed the team to expand the resource base significantly. The results from these additional drill holes have indicated a substantial increase in mineral resources, with some holes returning grades as high as 6.5 g/t, further validating the potential of the project. The cumulative data over the years demonstrate a clear upward trend in both the number of drill holes and the average grades achieved, with a total of 150 holes drilled across the project area, reflecting our commitment to advancing this promising mineral resource. The integration of advanced geological modeling and geophysical surveys has played a critical role in guiding our exploration efforts.
